blocks.text: ILOILO CITY, Philippines — Schools across Western Visayas suspended classes or shifted to online learning on Tuesday as the heat index is forecast to reach 43 degrees Celsius in Iloilo City and 42°C in Roxas City, Capiz. The class suspensions and adjustments cover public and private educational institutions in Iloilo and Capiz, with some schools suspending all academic activities. Other schools adopted remote learning arrangements to protect students and teachers from extreme heat. Among those implementing alternative learning arrangements are West Visayas State University (WVSU), University of the Philippines Visayas (UPV), Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT U), Central Philippine University […]...
